summary: Turn your Kobo into a remote control for your computer.
page_description: Pair with your computer and run favorite actions from large, clear controls.
release_notes: Say which deck is on screen and which computer is listening, and stop asking that computer for work several times a second.

steps.text: Create ~/.config/kobo/sidekick/deck.toml with the pages and controls you want on the reader.
Initialize the companion daemon to obtain its address, certificate, and pairing code.
Install the daemon certificate on the Kobo before pairing.

user: Somebody who wants their Kobo on the desk as a companion to the computer.
job: Turn the reader into a remote control for your computer.
offline: Nothing works without the pairing; the network is the job.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; re-pairing takes a moment

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to reach the computer it controls

non_goals: It does not mirror your computer's screen.
It does not control more than one pairing.
